name: Starberry Pie
description: A sweet pie baked with freshly harvested Starberries.
lore: A forest favorite baked with berries said to carry a little starlight inside them.

name: Strawberry Shortcake
description: A light, sweet cake made with strawberries and vanilla.
lore: Soft cake, sweet berries, and the sort of dessert that disappears far too quickly.

name: Spaghetti
description: A simple pasta dish with tomato sauce.
lore: A warm bowl of pasta made for long evenings around the table.

name: Grape Juice
description: A sweet drink made from fresh grapes.
lore: Freshly pressed, pleasantly sweet, and best served beneath the afternoon sun.

name: Veggie Platter
description: A colorful plate of fresh vegetables.
lore: A colorful little harvest arranged as neatly as a well-kept garden.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers filled with rice, tomato, and garlic.
lore: A garden harvest packed full of something warm and filling.

name: Cabbage Rolls
description: Cabbage leaves wrapped around a savory rice and tomato filling.
lore: Simple ingredients wrapped together into something unexpectedly comforting.

name: Skewers
description: Savory beef and vegetables served together on a skewer.
lore: Fire-roasted bites made for campfires, festivals, and wandering adventurers.

name: Tomato Soup
description: A warm tomato soup seasoned with garlic and onion.
lore: Warm enough to make even the rainiest forest evening feel cozy.

name: Fried Rice
description: A filling rice dish cooked with egg and yellow garlic.
lore: A quick, hearty meal with the unmistakable aroma of a busy kitchen.

name: Stew
description: A hearty stew made with vegetables, water, and your choice of meat.
lore: No two pots are quite the same, but somehow they always taste like home.

name: Fruit Salad
description: A fresh mixture of several fruits and berries.
lore: A bowl filled with whatever sweetness the season happened to offer.

name: Ice Cream
description: A cold dessert that can be flavored with different custom ingredients.
lore: Cold, creamy, and absolutely worth the trouble of keeping the ice frozen.

name: Garlic Bread
description: Warm bread flavored with fresh garlic.
lore: Crisp at the edges, soft in the middle, and impossible to ignore once you smell it.

name: Cotton Candy
description: A fluffy sweet treat made with cotton and sugar.
lore: A sugary cloud that seems to vanish the moment it touches your tongue.

name: Rice Pudding
description: A creamy dessert made with rice, milk, sugar, and vanilla.
lore: Creamy, gently sweet, and best eaten while it is still warm.

name: Sandwiches
description: A simple sandwich layered with lettuce and tomato.
lore: Nothing fancy—just a dependable meal for wherever the trail takes you.

name: Milkshakes
description: A chilled sweet drink made with milk, ice, sugar, and sweet berries.
lore: A frosty berry treat best enjoyed before the forest sun melts it.

name: Burger
description: A classic burger with beef, tomato, red onion, and lettuce.
lore: A hearty stack made for adventurers who came back from the mines very hungry.
